foundation_reset.approval_rule: Existing visual directions are hypotheses until a founder-approved territory and application quartet exist.
global_constraints: sentence case by default; no all-caps styling except established acronyms
no bulk asset generation before territory approval
automated scores are hygiene evidence and cannot override human rejection

operating_units.name: FrankX Demand
operating_units.voice: Sharp, direct, elite, tactical, controlled. Ruthless clarity, leverage, outcomes, systems.
operating_units.visual_direction: Provisional reset territory: human editorial authority. Show judgment becoming decisions and outcomes through real work, portraiture, annotations, publishing craft, and decisive composition. Light and dark modes are applications, not identity.
prompt_guardrails: No cockpit, market-screen, black-glass, or AI-dashboard styling
Do not hide the founder behind system imagery
Prefer real thinking, work, and outcomes
Treat the current logo and fonts as reassessment candidates

operating_units.name: Arcanea Product and IP
operating_units.voice: Mythic but precise; poetic but not vague.
operating_units.visual_direction: Provisional reset territory: crafted mythic publishing. Make worlds feel culturally real through specific characters, places, objects, maps, book arts, mineral color, and cinematic editorial scale.
prompt_guardrails: No generic portals, sigils, purple software, or spell-interface chrome
Keep canon, craft, and emotional specificity visible
Treat the current logo and fonts as reassessment candidates

operating_units.name: Starlight Substrate
operating_units.voice: Calm operational intelligence, trust, systems, evidence, and accountable action.
operating_units.visual_direction: Provisional reset territory: civic intelligence. Use clear institutional publishing, documentary proof, humane typography, rigorous diagrams, and evidence that remains calm under pressure. A night mode may exist, but nocturnal sci-fi is not the identity.
prompt_guardrails: No obsidian lab, smoked glass, oracle, hacker, or movie command-center styling
No decorative status chips or mono readouts
Build wordmark-first until a verified mark is approved

operating_units.name: AI-Architect / AI CoE
operating_units.visual_direction: Center of excellence diagrams, governance systems, operating-model maps, real proof and implementation artifacts.

operating_units.name: Agentic Income Network
operating_units.voice: Pragmatic conversion, trusted tools, fast path from attention to action.
operating_units.visual_direction: Revenue engines, offer paths, proof ladders, automation maps, dashboards with real metrics when available.

operating_units.name: Reality Architect
operating_units.voice: Transformational, structured, reflective, grounded in practices and systems.
operating_units.visual_direction: Life design maps, intentional systems, timeline architectures, reflective but concrete visual language.

operating_units.name: Creator Systems / ACOS
operating_units.voice: Creator-operating-system clarity: applied research, cohort outcomes, artifacts shipped publicly.
operating_units.visual_direction: Provisional reset territory for GenCreator: an open creative studio. Use daylight, people in process, tactile artifacts, expressive publishing, and visible progression from rough work to finished work.
prompt_guardrails: Do not blend with AnimeLegends mascots
No constellation, creator-stack, productivity-dashboard, or FrankX sub-brand styling
Make people, process, and owned work visible
Build the missing central brand pack only after territory approval

operating_units.name: Research and Mind Intelligence
operating_units.visual_direction: Research maps, mind systems, neural/cosmos inspiration only when grounded in evidence and provenance.
prompt_guardrails: Do not imply medical claims without source checks

operating_units.name: Tooling / OSS Distribution
operating_units.visual_direction: Repository proof, CLI flows, diagrams, install paths, before/after evidence, public OSS templates.
prompt_guardrails: Use real code or exact captures

operating_units.name: Anime Legends / Media IP
operating_units.voice: Mythic precision. Ancient knowledge. No hype.
operating_units.visual_direction: Anime-mythic media IP with reserved mascots, sigils, and lore systems; strong channel-specific assets.

incubator_lanes.decision_needed: Standalone brand, FrankX content vertical, or Arcanea studio capability

incubator_lanes.name: Health Intelligence
incubator_lanes.decision_needed: Research Intelligence, Arcanea creator vertical, or separate professional content lane

incubator_lanes.name: Dream / Life / Library Intelligence

incubator_lanes.name: Investor Intelligence
incubator_lanes.decision_needed: Commercial vertical, research lane, or archive candidate
